spec.name: 手写Logo v04
spec.prompt:
Edit the game logo in image1 to honor the user's explicit NEW request 换个手写体 and handwriting references images2 and3. Replace the existing uniform rounded bubble lettering with authentic charismatic HAND-WRITTEN CHINESE BRUSH LETTERING. This typography change must be clearly visible, not simply re-coloring the old font.

EXACT five Chinese characters: 交子赶工记. Top row 交子, bottom row 赶工记. Keep legibility and correct stroke structures (赶 is 走 + 干; 记 has 讠 + 己); no extra words. Optical hand-drawn spacing, natural slightly varied scale/baseline, lively human-made rhythm. Brush pressure changes create thick dark masses balanced by thinner rising/falling strokes; some angled cuts and naturally blunt brush ends, sparse small authentic dry-brush gaps, not blurry frayed ink, scribbling, distressed font noise or random broken strokes. Use the playful direct hand-written branding spirit of image2 (bold but unregular calligraphic logo), with image3's warm folk-handcrafted character. NOT a regular font, not uniformly smooth rounded noodles, not the angular polygon font from earlier attempts. Have an experienced Chinese lettering artist confidently draw a distinctive game title.

Lettering color very dark warm INK BROWN #352E29, almost black. Tiny cinnabar RED SEAL is the primary red accent. This solves previous excessive red/orange emphasis. Keep small ivory historical note and muted-bronze square-hole coin upper-left, modest little ivory cloud upper-right and tiny red seal right, adapting their size so the lettering is clearly the focus. The user wants a typography change, not copying the reference brands or mascot. NEVER include the names 云间有座小茶寮 or 文魁集 or their red-seal words, characters, ghost figure, clothing, weapon, slogans or English.

Keep the warm IVORY thin cut-paper backing of image1, but make its outline follow the new hand-lettered silhouette elegantly; do NOT recreate a huge scalloped gold/teal badge. Understated warm-tan offset paper layer and hairline grey-sage edge only. Very shallow short paper shadow, no 3D-extruded lettering, no thick cream bevel around each black stroke, no plastic shine or shiny gold. The letters should read as brushed ink printed on paper, not inflated individual 3D pieces. Supporting note, coin and cloud retain subtle clean paper collage. No other decorative additions.

Output one SQUARE 1:1 transparent-alpha PNG with natural wide logo centered inside the square, comfortable transparent padding; don't distort lettering to fill square. ALL background beyond the logo silhouette transparent, no cream rectangle or fake checkerboard. Edges clean, no colored matte fringe. Light paper tooth on backing only, not high-frequency grain across the text. Finished restrained Song-era papermill game wordmark with confident handcrafted lettering.
